# Syzygy endgame tables

Three- and four-piece WDL/DTZ tables generated by Ronald de Man, downloaded from the Lichess mirror https://tablebase.lichess.ovh/tables/standard/ . Source URLs, sizes and SHA-256 hashes for every file are in manifest.json. These data files are separate from the app source license.

Stockfish configuration: https://official-stockfish.github.io/docs/stockfish-wiki/UCI-Protocol-and-Stockfish-Commands.html#syzygypath
